Contact.heading: Contact & Info
Contact.getInTouchBody: Questions about the team, schedule, or anything else? Reach out!
Contact.coachHugoBio: Coach Hugo is a world-class coach and a true family man. He brings a wealth of experience, having played soccer from his teen years up to age 28. His coaching history is remarkable — leading youth clubs to championships and achieving undefeated streaks for five straight seasons. Every training session is designed to improve the team as a whole and each player individually, building real confidence on the field. For Coach Hugo, the most important thing isn't always winning, but ensuring kids get better and have fun playing this beautiful game.
Contact.coachingPhilosophyBody: Our training sessions are based on real game-day situations. We create scenarios that will happen in a game so kids know how to react and adapt to what's going on inside the field — building practical skills and tactical understanding for every player.
Contact.parentTestimonial: "Witnessing our child's growth and confidence blossom under Coach Hugo's guidance has been truly inspiring. Their approach to the game is exactly what young players need."

PushTutorial.title: Get Game Notifications
PushTutorial.subtitle: Stay updated on game times, scores & announcements
PushTutorial.iosNote: iOS requires the app to be installed to your Home Screen before notifications work.
PushTutorial.androidNote: Android supports notifications both from the browser and after adding to Home Screen.
PushTutorial.ios_1_desc: Push notifications only work through Safari on iPhone/iPad. Make sure you're using Safari, not Chrome or Firefox.
PushTutorial.ios_2_desc: Tap the Share icon at the bottom of the screen (the box with an arrow pointing up).
PushTutorial.ios_3_desc: Scroll down in the share sheet and tap "Add to Home Screen", then tap "Add" in the top right.
PushTutorial.ios_4_desc: Find the North Legends FC icon on your home screen and open it from there — not from Safari.
PushTutorial.ios_5_desc: Tap "Enable" on the notification banner that appears, or go to the bell icon in the menu and allow notifications.
PushTutorial.android_1_desc: Push notifications work best through Chrome on Android. Make sure you're using Chrome.
PushTutorial.android_2_desc: Tap the three-dot menu (⋮) in the top-right corner of Chrome.
PushTutorial.android_3_desc: Tap "Add to Home Screen" or "Install App". A shortcut will appear on your home screen.
PushTutorial.android_4_desc: Open North Legends FC from your home screen — it will open as a full-screen app.
PushTutorial.android_5_desc: Tap "Allow" when the browser asks for notification permission. Done!

WhatsNew.search_desc: Press ⌘K (or tap the search icon in the menu) to instantly find players, games, news, and pages. Try searching for an opponent name or a player number.
WhatsNew.photos_desc: Parents can now submit a photo for their player directly from the Roster page. Tap "Add photo" on your player's card — it goes to Coach Hugo for approval.
WhatsNew.push_desc: If you have the app on your Home Screen with notifications enabled, you'll get an automatic reminder at noon on every game day — no more missing kickoff times.
